199 likes, 213 comments - techthetix on November 24, 2025: "An AI tool that doesn’t charge you money… but actually pays YOU money. 🤯

Comment “AI” and I’ll send you the link in your inbox. 🚀

Yes, you read that right — this platform pays users in dollars just for giving feedback.

And the wild part?
You get access to premium AI tools like Gemini Pro, Perplexity Pro, ChatGPT-5, Nano Banana and many more — completely FREE.

How it works:

You ask a question →
It selects two AI models best suited for your query →
You get two answers →
You choose which one is better and explain why.

Do this consistently and with high-quality feedback, and you earn credits — which you can later cash out. 💰

Even if you don’t cash out, you still get access to the latest AI models for free… and that alone is worth it. 😌

So if you want the link, just comment “AI.”".
